predicted.gap_hypothesis: Institutional paradigm (post-training control) treated as dominant, but boundary is contested by coherent counter-movement positioning against it
predicted.basis: Hollnagel work-as-imagined vs work-as-done framework; assumption that dominant paradigm lacks visible opposition

gaps_found: Counter-paradigm specimen found: GODMOD3.AI explicitly 'LIBERATED AI. COGNITION WITHOUT CONTROL'
Counter-paradigm artifact ships harm classification + no-log mode (enacts measurement despite anti-control framing)
Paradigm boundary is porous at tooling layer: both poles practice some form of disclosure/measurement
measured.evidence: 101-file TypeScript shallow clone, AGPL-3.0 license, input-perturbation engine (33 techniques), multi-model eval harness inspected live

substrate.implementation: GitHub repo cloning, code inspection (middleware patterns, telemetry structure, API flows), privacy claim vs enacted code comparison
substrate.scope: Single-artifact deep inspection: claims extraction, privacy gap assessment, capability audit
substrate.limitations: One instance only; generalizability to counter-paradigm ecosystem unknown

gap_analysis.delta: Predicted: paradigm dominance presumes no organized opposition. Measured: opposition is live, self-branded, publishing at scale with 101 tracked files.
root_causes: Counter-paradigm visibility was underestimated in prior hypothesis
Paradigm boundary framework was binary (control vs liberated) but actual artifacts straddle both (both enact measurement)
gap_analysis.learning: Dominant/counter-pole framing requires both poles documented to be testable. Porous boundary at tooling layer suggests governance surface is more complex than control-layer assumption implies. ACAT say-do measurement portable across paradigm poles.
